g.text: Recorded private GCP lab / CPU control plane and GPU worker
Direct Feature API demo uses PC loopback :18082 → Service :80; HTTPS is a separate path.
MLflow bridge: KFP tracking:5000 → CPU private socket :15002 → Docker tracking:5000.
The PC Compose profile has PostgreSQL/Spark and a standalone prediction container.
The namespaces, persistent volumes and GPU shown above belong to the reference lab.
Boxes group owned runtimes or workloads. Arrows label the transport or artifact.
See the guide for source manifests, volume mounts and recorded deployment scope.
